title: count-catcher: Lean Theorems from Model Counting Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2610.36196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present count-catcher, a tool that turns a CPOG certificate of a count by the exact model counter d4 into a Lean theorem that a CNF formula defined in Lean has exactly N models over V variables. With an encoding lemma, this theorem becomes a theorem about the number of combinatorial objects. A CPOG certificate consists of a Boolean circuit equivalent to the formula and a proof of equivalence. count-catcher checks in Lean that the formula implies the circuit (forward check) and the circuit implies the formula (reverse check). For the forward check, lrat-catcher streams a refutation through the LRAT checker of Lean's standard library. The reverse check and the validity check of the circuit are computations proved correct in Lean. Lean runs all three checks as compiled code, so the theorem depends on Lean's kernel, compiler and runtime, as does CPOG's verified checker. tldr: count-catcher 工具将精确模型计数器 d4 的 CPOG 计数证书转化为 Lean 中经过验证的定理，证明 CNF 公式（进而对应的组合对象）恰好有 N 个模型。
